title: ML basics, bias-variance, overfitting
scope: What is ML, types of learning, bias-variance tradeoff, over/underfitting, generalization, cross-validation concepts, no-free-lunch, parametric vs non-parametric, discriminative vs generative, curse of dimensionality, general ML theory

title: Supervised learning: regression and classification models
scope: Linear/logistic regression, SVM, kNN, naive Bayes, GLMs, multicollinearity, assumptions, kernel methods, class imbalance handling at the model level

title: Decision trees, ensembles, boosting
scope: Decision trees, random forest, bagging, boosting, AdaBoost, gradient boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, stacking, feature importance of tree models

title: Unsupervised learning: clustering and dimensionality reduction
scope: k-means, hierarchical, DBSCAN, GMM/EM, PCA, SVD, t-SNE, UMAP, LDA(dim-red), topic modelling basics, autoencoders-as-dim-red mention

title: Feature engineering and data preparation
scope: Missing values, encoding categorical, scaling/normalization, outliers, feature selection, imbalanced data resampling/SMOTE, data leakage, train/val/test splitting, data augmentation (general), dataset quality, labeling

title: Evaluation metrics and validation
scope: Precision/recall/F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, log loss, RMSE/MAE, R2, confusion matrix, calibration, cross-validation strategies, offline vs online metrics, ranking metrics (NDCG, MAP), hyperparameter tuning, model selection, model interpretability (SHAP/LIME)

title: Loss functions, optimization, regularization
scope: Loss/cost functions, gradient descent variants, convexity, L1/L2/elastic net, MLE/MAP, regularization theory, convergence, learning rate, closed-form solutions

title: Probability, statistics and A/B testing
scope: Distributions, Bayes theorem, hypothesis testing, p-values, confidence intervals, CLT, correlation vs causation, A/B test design, sampling, bootstrapping, Bayesian inference, expectation/variance, probability puzzles asked in DS interviews

title: Linear algebra, calculus and math for ML
scope: Matrices, eigenvalues, SVD, norms, derivatives, chain rule, Jacobian/Hessian, information theory (entropy, KL), optimization math, vector calculus for ML

title: Recommender systems, time series, anomaly detection
scope: Collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, cold start, two-tower retrieval models, ARIMA, forecasting, seasonality, anomaly/fraud detection, survival analysis, causal inference basics

title: Reinforcement learning
scope: MDPs, Q-learning, policy gradients, actor-critic, exploration vs exploitation, bandits, DQN, PPO as RL algorithm (not RLHF), model-based vs model-free

title: Neural network basics and backpropagation
scope: Perceptron, MLP, activation functions, backprop, vanishing/exploding gradients, weight init, universal approximation, deep learning vs ML

title: Training deep nets: optimizers, normalization, regularization
scope: SGD/Adam/AdamW/RMSprop, learning-rate schedules and warmup, batch/layer norm, dropout, early stopping, gradient clipping, mixed precision, batch size effects, hyperparameter tuning for DL, debugging training

title: CNNs and computer vision
scope: Convolutions, pooling, ResNet/VGG/EfficientNet, ViT in CV context, object detection (YOLO, RCNN), segmentation, image classification, data augmentation for images, transfer learning for vision, OCR, image metrics (IoU, mAP)

title: RNN, LSTM, GRU and sequence models
scope: RNN, LSTM, GRU, seq2seq, BPTT, bidirectional, CTC, state-space models (Mamba) as RNN alternatives, sequence modelling pre-transformer

title: Generative models: GAN, VAE, diffusion
scope: GANs, VAEs, autoencoders, normalizing flows, diffusion models, Stable Diffusion, text-to-image, classifier-free guidance, generative model evaluation (FID)

title: Classic NLP and word embeddings
scope: TF-IDF, bag of words, n-grams, word2vec, GloVe, fastText, NER, POS tagging, text classification, sentiment, BLEU/ROUGE/perplexity, BERT-era NLP tasks, stemming/lemmatization

title: PyTorch / TensorFlow / framework questions
scope: PyTorch autograd, tensors, nn.Module, DataLoader, TF/Keras, GPU memory, distributed data parallel API questions, torch.compile, numpy/pandas/scikit-learn API questions for ML work

title: Attention and Transformer architecture
scope: Self-attention, multi-head attention, scaled dot-product, encoder/decoder, residuals, layer norm placement, FFN, masked attention, cross-attention, complexity of attention, FlashAttention, MQA/GQA, BERT vs GPT vs T5

title: Tokenization, embeddings and positional encoding
scope: BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece, vocabulary size, token embeddings, sinusoidal/learned/RoPE/ALiBi positional encodings, context extension via position interpolation

title: LLM architectures, MoE and scaling laws
scope: Decoder-only vs encoder-decoder, mixture of experts, scaling laws (Chinchilla), model families (LLaMA, GPT, Mistral, Gemma, DeepSeek), emergent abilities, state-space/hybrid models, small language models

title: Pretraining, data and distributed training
scope: Pretraining objectives (CLM, MLM), training data curation/dedup/filtering, data parallel, tensor/pipeline/sequence parallel, ZeRO/FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, mixed precision, checkpointing, training stability, GPU memory math, compute cost

title: Decoding, sampling and context length
scope: Greedy, beam, top-k, top-p, temperature, repetition penalty, speculative decoding, constrained/structured decoding, context window limits, lost-in-the-middle, long-context techniques

title: Inference optimization, KV cache, quantization
scope: KV cache, PagedAttention/vLLM, continuous batching, quantization (INT8/INT4, GPTQ, AWQ), pruning, distillation for serving, throughput vs latency, TTFT/TPOT, GPU serving, model parallel inference, cost of serving LLMs

title: LLM evaluation, benchmarks and hallucination
scope: Perplexity, BLEU/ROUGE, MMLU/HumanEval benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, human eval, hallucination causes/mitigation, contamination, eval design, reasoning models, chain-of-thought as capability

title: Supervised fine-tuning and instruction tuning
scope: Full fine-tuning, SFT, instruction tuning, dataset preparation, chat templates, catastrophic forgetting, domain adaptation, hyperparameters for fine-tuning, when to fine-tune, evaluation of fine-tuned model

title: PEFT: LoRA, QLoRA, adapters
scope: LoRA rank/alpha, QLoRA, adapters, prefix/prompt tuning, IA3, memory math of fine-tuning, merging adapters, DoRA

title: RLHF, DPO, PPO, GRPO and preference tuning
scope: Reward model, RLHF pipeline, PPO for LLMs, DPO/IPO/KTO, GRPO, RLVR, reward hacking, constitutional AI, preference data collection, alignment

title: Distillation, model merging, continual learning
scope: Knowledge distillation, synthetic data generation, model merging (TIES, SLERP), continual learning, multi-task, curriculum, test-time compute/scaling

title: RAG vs fine-tuning vs prompting decisions
scope: Choosing between prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, or combinations; cost/latency/freshness/privacy tradeoffs; build-vs-buy; open vs closed models

title: RAG fundamentals and pipeline
scope: What is RAG, components, indexing vs query flow, why RAG, naive RAG limits, grounding, citations, context assembly, RAG architecture questions

title: Chunking and document processing
scope: Chunk size/overlap, semantic/recursive/structure-aware chunking, parsing PDFs/tables/images, metadata, OCR, document ingestion pipelines, parent-child chunks

title: Embeddings, vector databases and ANN indexes
scope: Embedding models, similarity metrics, fine-tuning embeddings, Matryoshka, vector DBs (Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus, pgvector), HNSW, IVF, PQ, ANN tradeoffs, filtering, sharding vectors

title: Hybrid search, reranking, query transformation
scope: BM25, sparse vs dense, hybrid and RRF, cross-encoder rerankers, ColBERT, query rewriting, HyDE, multi-query, routing, metadata filtering, retrieval metrics

title: Advanced RAG: GraphRAG, agentic RAG
scope: GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, agentic/adaptive/self-RAG, corrective RAG, multi-hop, multimodal RAG, long-context vs RAG, caching, memory-augmented retrieval

title: RAG evaluation and failure modes
scope: RAGAS, faithfulness, context precision/recall, answer relevance, hallucination in RAG, debugging bad retrieval, stale data, security (prompt injection through docs), production issues

title: Prompt engineering and context engineering
scope: Zero/few-shot, chain-of-thought, ReAct prompts, system prompts, structured output, prompt injection basics, prompt versioning, context engineering, prompt caching

title: Tool use, function calling and MCP
scope: Function calling, tool schemas, MCP, structured outputs/JSON mode, API design for tools, tool error handling, code interpreters, computer use

title: Agents: planning, memory, multi-agent
scope: Agent loops, ReAct, planning, reflection, memory (short/long-term), multi-agent orchestration, LangChain/LangGraph/AutoGen/CrewAI, agent evaluation, reliability, human-in-the-loop, A2A

title: LLMOps, observability, cost and latency
scope: Tracing, monitoring, eval pipelines in prod, cost optimization, caching, model routing, rate limits, latency budgets, A/B testing LLM features, versioning, CI for prompts, deployment of LLM apps

title: Safety, guardrails, security and jailbreaks
scope: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, red teaming, guardrails, PII, content moderation, data poisoning, model extraction, bias/fairness, responsible AI, privacy, OWASP LLM top 10

title: Multimodal, vision and audio models
scope: CLIP, VLMs, multimodal LLMs, speech (Whisper, TTS), video, image generation APIs, OCR with LLMs, multimodal embeddings, voice agents

title: MLOps, deployment and monitoring
scope: CI/CD for ML, model registry, serving (batch/online/streaming), canary/shadow, drift detection, monitoring, retraining, experiment tracking, reproducibility, containers for ML, edge deployment, Kubeflow/MLflow

title: Data pipelines and feature stores
scope: ETL/ELT, Spark, streaming (Kafka, Flink), feature stores, training-serving skew, data quality, data versioning, labeling pipelines, data warehouses/lakes for ML

title: ML system design: framework and case studies
scope: The ML system design interview framework (requirements, metrics, data, features, model, serving, evaluation) and concrete prompts: design recommender / feed ranking / search ranking / ads CTR / fraud detection / spam / ETA / content moderation / visual search / personalization

title: GenAI / LLM system design case studies
scope: Design prompts: RAG chatbot over enterprise docs, code assistant, customer-support agent, LLM gateway, semantic search, multi-tenant LLM platform, doc Q&A, text-to-SQL, voice assistant, evaluation platform, agent platform

scope: Horizontal vs vertical scaling, load balancers (L4/L7), reverse proxy, CDN, caching strategies and eviction, cache invalidation, consistent hashing, rate limiting, back-of-envelope estimation, latency numbers, performance

title: Databases, sharding, replication, consistency
scope: SQL vs NoSQL choice, sharding/partitioning, replication, leader-follower, indexing at scale, consistency models, ACID vs BASE, eventual consistency, data modelling for scale, search indexes, time-series/graph stores, blob storage

scope: Concrete 'Design X' prompts: URL shortener, Pastebin, Twitter/feed, Instagram, WhatsApp/chat, YouTube/Netflix, Uber, Dropbox, web crawler, typeahead, notification system, rate limiter service, ticket booking, payment system, distributed cache/KV store, search engine, Google Docs, leaderboard, etc.

scope: Process vs thread, PCB, context switch, system calls, IPC, virtual memory, paging, segmentation, page replacement, TLB, memory management, kernel/user mode, boot, file systems, I/O, interrupts

scope: OSI/TCP-IP layers, TCP vs UDP, handshake, congestion/flow control, HTTP/1.1/2/3, HTTPS/TLS, DNS, what happens when you type a URL, IP/subnetting/NAT, ARP, routing, sockets, REST basics, cookies/sessions, proxies/firewalls, WebSockets

scope: Relational model, normalization, keys, ER diagrams, SQL queries/joins/window functions/group by, ACID, isolation levels, locking/MVCC, deadlocks in DB, B-tree/B+ tree/hash indexes, query optimization/explain plans, stored procedures, views, triggers, concurrency control

scope: Symmetric/asymmetric crypto, hashing, digital signatures, TLS certificates, OWASP top 10, XSS, CSRF, SQL injection, authentication/authorization, OAuth, JWT, password storage, CORS, web security basics
